subject: Ligue 1
title: What is Ligue 1? France's top soccer league, explained
answer: Ligue 1 is the top professional soccer league in France. Eighteen clubs play 34 matches each from August to May, and the team with the most points wins the French championship. Paris Saint-Germain is the reigning champion, with a record 14 titles, the last five in a row. In the U.S., Ligue 1 matches air on beIN Sports.
body:
How the season works: each club plays every other club twice, once at home and once away, for 34 matchdays and 306 games. A win is worth three points and a draw one. The 2026-27 season started Aug. 21, 2026, pauses for a winter break after matchday 14, resumes the weekend of Jan. 2, 2027, and ends May 29, 2027. The league cut its size from 20 to 18 clubs starting with the 2023-24 season.

What's at stake: the top three clubs go straight to the UEFA Champions League league phase, fourth place enters the Champions League third qualifying round, fifth goes to the Europa League and sixth to the Conference League play-off round. The winner of the Coupe de France, the national cup, earns a Europa League spot. At the bottom, the last two clubs drop to Ligue 2, and the 16th-place club plays a two-legged play-off against a Ligue 2 side to keep its place. For 2026-27, Troyes and Le Mans were promoted, replacing relegated Nantes and Metz.

Who wins: PSG clinched the 2025-26 title in May 2026 with 76 points, its 14th league championship, a French record. Other well-known clubs include Olympique de Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais, AS Monaco, Lille, Lens and Rennes. Ligue 1 is usually counted among Europe's "Big Five" leagues, with England's Premier League, Spain's La Liga, Italy's Serie A and Germany's Bundesliga.

How to watch in the U.S.: beIN Sports is the U.S. home of Ligue 1, on its TV channels and its beIN Sports streaming service; matches are also carried on live-TV services that include beIN. Because of the time difference, most weekend games kick off in the morning or early afternoon Eastern time.

faq.q: How many teams are in Ligue 1?
faq.a: 18, since the 2023-24 season. Each plays 34 league matches.

faq.q: Who has won the most Ligue 1 titles?
faq.a: Paris Saint-Germain, with 14, including five in a row through 2025-26.

How does relegation work in Ligue 1?
faq.a: The bottom two clubs go down to Ligue 2, and the 16th-place club plays a two-legged play-off against a Ligue 2 team.

faq.q: How many Ligue 1 teams make the Champions League?
faq.a: The top three go directly to the league phase and the fourth-place team enters the qualifying rounds.
It is French for "League 1," the first division. The second division is Ligue 2.
